name: Nozomi
source:
A young mother who has just had her baby whom [url=https://vndb.org/c10013]Natsuki[/url] meets in the outside courtyard of the hospital and who is hospitalized because she has cancer, they will get along fairly quickly. 
She is good advice and will help Natsuki reorder her feelings.
